contract: Default Frappe Desk controls and stylesheet only; no Cutting CSS, no extra subtitle; Vietnamese/English shared catalog.

accessibility.evidence: All public input/select controls have explicit labels. Fullscreen, network, settings, sync, and clear-filter icon buttons have localized accessible names. Device setup opens in a labeled dialog, focuses the device ID, and restores focus to its trigger on close. Desk report selects have aria-labels.

responsive.evidence: Rendered all four target sizes. Document scrollWidth equals viewport width; entry and records cards stack on phone widths and sit side by side from 1024px.

visualReview.evidence: Live Frappe page uses only desk.bundle.css. Fullscreen toggled on and off, the network control reported connectivity, and device settings opened and returned focus. Client-only offline mock data showed that ID/product filters and pagination update the displayed rows; no records were sent to the site.

loading.evidence: Slow 3G snapshot displayed the localized loading status while retaining the approved device and cached rows.

empty.evidence: Unregistered tablet shows no records and disabled entry controls; live Desk report shows the native empty message.

error.evidence: Invalid master selection displays a localized validation error; offline sync displays a localized retained-queue error.

partial.evidence: Offline screenshot retains cached catalog and synchronized rows alongside one pending local row.

success.evidence: Reconnect automatically drained the queue to zero; API returned exactly the new row with quantity 4 and an ISO UTC timestamp. Desk Restore produced the fourth audit action.

permission.evidence: Unapproved entry is disabled in the public UI. Backend integration tests reject a Pending device and anonymous reports. Manager can open its own native import form.

renderedEvidence.observation: Narrow phone: branded toolbar and entry card fit without horizontal overflow; filter card follows below.
Phone view stacks the entry and saved-record cards; standard Desk controls and filters remain reachable.
Entry card remains on the left; saved records, filters, and table sit on the right.
Distinct left entry and right records cards, logo, filters, and header icons; default Desk stylesheet only.
